howItWorks.title: From choosing the tea to flawless guest service
howItWorks.intro: Designed to save time for chefs, procurement managers and restaurant managers.

steps.title: Choose your teas
steps.body: Select teas from the wide Ahmad Tea range and add them to “My selection” with no upfront commitment.

steps.title: Request a quote
steps.body: Tell us your estimated volumes or preferred format: loose-leaf tea, premium silk pyramids or hygienic classic envelopes.

steps.title: Get a personal offer within 24 h
steps.body: We'll prepare an individual wholesale price list based on your volumes and send a free tasting kit to your team.

why.title: Why Lithuanian hotels and restaurants choose UAB „Temus“
why.intro: Over 25 years of working with the country's leading hospitality businesses.

reasons.title: Local warehouse in Lithuania
reasons.body: The most popular Ahmad Tea range is always in stock in our Vilnius warehouse, so you never run short — even in the busiest season.

reasons.title: Fast, reliable delivery
reasons.body: Orders delivered across Lithuania within 24–48 hours, straight to your storeroom or kitchen with no intermediary delays.

reasons.title: Flexible order quantities
reasons.body: A tailored minimum order per product lets you order exactly what your venue needs, without tying up cash in stock.

reasons.title: Free kits and training
reasons.body: We provide tea samples and elegant wooden presentation stands, and train your staff in the art of proper brewing.

about.title: British quality and family-business responsibility since 1995
about.p1: For more than two decades, UAB „Temus“ has represented the world-renowned Ahmad Tea London brand in Lithuania. We value a personal relationship with every partner — from a cosy Old Town café to the largest resort hotel chains in the Baltics.
about.p2: We guarantee direct supply from certified factories, impeccable product freshness and professional tea-culture support for your staff. Our goal is to make every cup of tea in your venue a flawless experience for your guests.
about.cardBody: Stored at a controlled temperature in Vilnius to preserve essential oils and aroma.
